newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks gain slightly in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks gain slightly in thin trading.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed with slight gains on both the Bogota and Medellin exchanges after a session of thin but stable trading.

Bogota's IBB general price index ended at 862.73 points, up 0.17 percent, on trading volume of 6.75 billion pesos. The IBOMED index in Medellin rose 0.36 percent on volume of one billion pesos to 13,452.80.
"The market showed the same trend as has emerged in previous days and remained very stable," one Bogota broker said.

In the day's session on the Bogota exchange, the main movers were Banco de Bogota with a 115.5 million peso trade at a stable 5.960 pesos per share and Banco Ganadero shares, which closed 0.17 percent down at 282 pesos on a 91.5 million peso volume. Banco Colombia remained unchanged at 436 pesos on a trading volume of 61 million pesos.

In Medellin, chocolate manufacturer Compaa Nacional de Chocolates generated most interest, closing 1.01 percent down at 8,350 pesos on a total trade of 170 million pesos. Over 163 million pesos in cement manufacturer Cementos Caribe shares changed hands, ending down 4.63 percent down at 3,910 pesos.
Banco de Bogota remained unchanged at 5,960 pesos on a day's trade of 145.8 million pesos.
The drop in Cementos Caribe was largely due to depressed trading in its shares in recent days, according to one Medellin broker.

"One or two small Cementos Caribe shareholders were selling today and they had little option, but to take that price. But its probable that the trend will soon be reversed," the broker said. He added that shares are gradually returning to normal price levels after sharp declines in past weeks.
